## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `KeyDashboardServiceClient`: Provides a cross-region view of all Cloud KMS keys in a given Cloud project. (Recommended starting point)
- `KeyTrackingServiceClient`: Returns information about the resources in an org that are protected by a given Cloud KMS key via CMEK.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `KeyDashboardServiceClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudKMSInventoryV1
import GoogleCloudKMSV1

func sample(parent: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudKMSInventoryV1.KeyDashboardServiceClient()
  let items = client.listCryptoKeysByItems(
    request: ListCryptoKeysRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "\(parent)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-kms-inventory-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-kms-inventory-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudKMSInventoryV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudKMSInventoryV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-kms-inventory-v1
```
